subject: Game Theory
title: The Future of Auctions
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Future of Auctions.

hook.text: Auctions are expanding into new domains: cloud computing, drone airspace, even parking spots.

buildup.text: Dynamic pricing—adjusting in real time—brings auction logic to ride-sharing, hotels, and groceries.

discovery.text: AI-powered auction designers can optimize rules for specific markets faster than human economists.

twist.text: Privacy concerns grow: personalized auctions may charge each buyer their maximum willingness to pay.

climax.text: The core insight endures: when you don't know the price, let competition discover it.

quiz.question: What privacy concern do personalized auctions raise?
options: Charging each buyer their maximum willingness to pay
